items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: And I played with Buddy Petit up on the dance line. Cronlott and Canel in the old dance line used to be up there.

ctx.x: Joe Yeah they decided to cut it short. Well they didn't stop a lot of the other places did they?

Joe It didn't go to Gertrude Dennis. Joe No it didn't look like a carnival you know what I mean? You didn't see nothing. There was just very few people in the street and it was nothing exciting. Joe And I played with Buddy Petit up on the dance line. Cronlott and Canel in the old dance line used to be up there.
